what: During a stretch when no automated task was running at all, only hand-run steps happened one after another, wasting time nothing was actively working during. The only queued work at that point belonged to a different, not-yet-started track of work, and nothing suggested starting it.
rule: When the only queued work belongs to a not-yet-started track, its first, read-only step should start during idle stretches instead of nothing running at all.
fix: Enforcement: the idle-time warning now offers a hint naming that first step, and the same hint is available as its own on-demand command. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-o.test.mjs`.
